0.desc: Animal Star Cookies is a balanced hybrid strain expertly crafted by Greenpoint Seeds, born from the union of Animal Cookies and Stardawg. This unique blend combines the soothing qualities of an indica with the uplifting effects of a sativa, offering a gentle yet powerful experience that calms the body and elevates the spirit. With its harmonious nature, Animal Star Cookies helps users relax and find themselves in a state of emotional well-being. The strain's rich terpene profile contributes to its complex flavors and effects. Sweet and earthy notes are complemented by hints of vanilla and nutty undertones, creating a delightful and nuanced taste experience. The presence of Limonene adds a subtle citrus zest, while Linalool imparts gentle floral accents. These terpenes enhance not only the flavor but also promote a calming and uplifting mood. Drawing from its parent genetics, Animal Star Cookies inherits the full-body relaxation characteristic of Animal Cookies and the mood-enhancing properties of Stardawg. Users often report feelings of tranquility and happiness, with a gentle elevation of mood that eases away stress and encourages a positive mindset. This balanced hybrid is ideal for those seeking to unwind while maintaining a sense of alertness and emotional well-being. Strain Type: Hybrid Lineage: [Animal Cookies] x [Stardawg] Breeder: Greenpoint Seeds Terpene Profile: Humulene, Limonene, Myrcene, Nerolidol 2, Pinene, Linalool Top Reported Strain Effects: Calming, Relaxing, Uplifting, Alert, Tranquil Top Report Strain Flavors: Sweet, Vanilla, Nutty, Earthy

1.desc:
Ghost OG, a cut of OG Kush, is a hybrid strain loved for its balanced cerebral and body effects.  Often described as simultaneously potent and non-intrusive, Ghost OG has won itself Cup awards and renown among consumers. 

Despite its intimidating name, Ghost OG is actually a mellow, relaxing strain that’s great for recreational use. This is the strain to go to when you’re having a Netflix-and-Chill day at home. As an indica-dominant hybrid, Ghost OG can melt all your worries, stressors, and anxieties away and replace them with a soothing, peaceful experience. There’s nothing better than watching your favorite comedy or listening to your favorite album than with Ghost OG in the mix.

Even though the high of Ghost OG is noticeable, it’s rarely considered to be too overpowering or overwhelming. This hybrid comes with moderate THC levels that are suitable for all smoking levels. The overall experience of Ghost OG is zen, euphoric, and giggly. This hybrid produces a happy high that veers on the cerebral side in the early stages.

The second wave of Ghost OG shows its indica side. The brain and body enter a state of pure relaxation. This can help combat feelings of pain, anxiety, nausea, and inflammation. Any discomfort in the body with gradually fade away as you continue to smoke Ghost OG on the couch. It also might be a good idea to keep snacks around as this strain promotes the munchies.

Strain Type: Hybrid

Lineage: [Afghani] x [OG Kush]

Breeder: Apothecary Genetics

Primary Terpene Profile: b-Caryophylenne, Nerolidol 2, b-Myrcene, a-Bisabolol

Top Reported Strain Effects: Relaxed, Happy, Euphoric

Top Report Strain Flavors: Earthy, Citrus, Sweet

2.desc:
Orange Push Pop cured resin badder is a smooth, citrus-forward indica-leaning hybrid concentrate with roots deep in LA's underground scene. Originally bred by Seed Junkie and pheno-hunted by a legendary trap grower on Skid Row, this rare cut spent two years in tissue culture before returning to the spotlight -- stronger and louder than ever.

Each 1G jar features glistening, honey-like badder that delivers a creamy citrus blast on the inhale, with a mellow, flavorful finish. Cold extracted to preserve the full terpene spectrum, this concentrate offers a nostalgic, orange-cream flavor profile wrapped in calming, euphoric effects. A true street gem turned connoisseur classic.

ABOUT THE BRAND:

Locals Only Concentrates sources their marijuana from in-house New Jersey indoor farms. Their cultivators tailor the grow conditions to the strain.

The proof is in purity, and Locals Only Concentrates is a connoisseur quality brand with a line of extracts that exude perfection. Making the perfect extract requires a lot of vetting and Locals Only Concentrates are more than happy to put in the work and extra steps it takes to bring the absolute best to market.

This due diligence is seen in their other products, too. Locals Only Concentrates have taken marijuana to new levels with their proprietary Extraction methods. Locals Only Concentrates are not CRC scrubbers, their clear look is achieved through purity, not from bleaching.

3.desc: Diamond Bar Wet Badder is a sharp, sativa-leaning hybrid concentrate that brings electric flavor and record-breaking potency. Bred by crossing Diamond Dust with a select Fig Bar Male (GSE 55), this in-house creation sets a new bar—literally. The first lab test shattered expectations, clocking in at an impressive 4.4% total terpenes, delivering a powerhouse sensory experience. Packed into a 1g jar of rich, velvety badder, Diamond Bar hits with a refreshing burst of Lime Gatorade-like citrus, followed by a bright, energetic lift that’s perfect for daytime sessions. This concentrate is for those who want bold flavor, top-tier terpene content, and a buzz that cuts through the noise.

4.desc: The perfect tasty strain for any relaxed night spent at home, Lemon Cherry Gelato brings on an amazing flavor and effects that will leave you in pure bliss. This bud has a taste much like its name suggests – sour lemons plus rich cherries and berries! The aroma is just as delightful, with a sour citrusy overtone accented by fresh berries and raspberries and just a hint of earthy pine. The Lemon Cherry Gelato high consists of soothing effects that will have you feeling kicked back and at ease. You'll feel a boost of happiness at the onset of the high, immediately erasing any negative moods or racing thoughts. This quickly turns stoney, leaving you unfocused and fading in and out of heady bliss. As your mind settles, your body will soon follow, leaving you fully relaxed from head to toe. Lemon Cherry Gelato is often chosen to treat conditions such as mood swings, chronic pain, chronic stress or anxiety and depression.

5.desc: The Strain: Max AC stands as a pinnacle of hybrid ingenuity, brought to life by Greenpoint Genetics through an inspired cross of MAC 1 and Animal Cookies. This strain captures the essence of two powerhouse genetics, blending the resin-rich, robust character of MAC 1 with the flavor-forward, distinctive profile of Animal Cookies. The result is a hybrid that delivers a compelling fusion of clear headed euphoria and soothing physical calm, tailored for those seeking both mental spark and grounded relaxation. The flavor profile of Max AC is a journey in complexity and depth. It opens with a bright citrus burst provided by limonene, delivering an immediate zing that awakens the senses. The spicy, peppery nuances of caryophyllene interlace with the rich, earthy foundation of myrcene and humulene, creating a multi-layered taste that is both robust and satisfying. Bisabolol rounds out the experience with subtle floral hints, adding an elegant softness that completes the symphony of flavors. The result is an immersive, gourmet experience that dances between tangy citrus, spicy earthiness, and delicate floral sweetness. As the high unfolds, Max AC sets the stage for a state of inspired focus and tranquil contentment. The initial rush sparks an elevated mood, fueling creative thoughts and a sense of invigorated drive ideal for sketching out new ideas or engaging in reflective planning. Gradually, a soothing calm pervades the body, nurturing a feeling of quiet satisfaction and mental clarity. Max AC's dynamic progression from an energizing lift to a serene, grounding calm invites you to embrace an active, yet reflective state, transforming your day into an exploration of both creative vibrancy and peaceful repose.Strain Type: Hybrid Lineage: [Mac 1] x [Animal Cookies] Breeder: Greenpoint Genetics Primary Terpene Profile: Caryophyllene, Limonene, Humulene, Myrcene, Bisabolol Top Reported Strain Effects: Calm, Contented, Motivated, Uplifted, Peaceful Top Reported Strain Flavors: Citrus, Creamy, Spicy, Earthy, Herbal, Floral The Product: Uncured fresh frozen plant material created into a frosting/peanut-butter like substance that is high in terpene content allowing maximum flavor and effect. This consistency is easy to handle and on par with live budder for potency.

6.desc:
Kandy Cake is a cured resin badder crafted from Bass River Buds’ organically grown, no-till living soil flower, bringing together the rich genetic pairing of Kut Throat Kandy x Ice Cream Cake in a terpene-forward concentrate format. Carefully dried, cured, and extracted to preserve the cultivar’s natural complexity, this batch delivers a dense, creamy profile layered with candy sweetness, vanilla frosting, earthy gas, and subtle citrus brightness. Floral undertones and soft spice from its dominant terpene blend round out the finish with classic cured resin depth and full-bodied character.

Led by high levels of ß-Caryophyllene alongside Limonene, ß-Myrcene, and Linalool, Kandy Cake offers a balanced aromatic profile that moves between sweet dessert richness and savory fuel notes without losing the cultivar’s natural expression. The badder consistency provides a smooth, workable texture ideal for flavorful concentrate sessions while staying true to the source flower.

Produced as part of the Eclipse x Bass River Buds collaboration, this cured resin badder is made from 100% cannabis with nothing added — preserving the integrity of the flower, the extraction, and the cultivar-driven terpene profile from start to finish.

7.desc:
SUN X Megaleaf marks a first-of-its-kind collaboration: the first extracts made with Megaleaf flower in New Jersey.

MegaBoof, also known as Super Boof, is a balanced hybrid bred from Black Cherry Punch and Tropicana Cookies. This terpene-rich cured resin badder delivers loud fermented cherry notes layered with sweet orange citrus and subtle funky undertones. Dominant beta-caryophyllene brings a bold spicy depth while limonene and linalool add bright citrus and soft floral complexity, creating a flavorful and expressive concentrate experience.

The smooth badder consistency preserves the cultivar’s rich cannabis character and terpene profile, offering a workable texture designed for flavorful concentrate sessions. Eclipse X Megaleaf showcases this strain with a true-to-plant cured resin extraction made from 100% cannabis with nothing added.

Crafted with a focus on terpene preservation, flavor expression, and extraction quality, this MegaBoof badder delivers a rich, strain-forward profile with layered cannabis flavor from start to finish.

8.desc:
Sherb Cake is a hybrid cannabis strain, bred from popular indica-dominant parents Girl Scout Cookies and Pink Panties. Fans of the Sherb Cake strain love its creamy, fruity flavor and claim that it is a great strain for relaxing sensations. 

Uncured fresh frozen plant material created into a frosting/peanut-butter like substance that is high in terpene content allowing maximum flavor and effect. This consistency is easy to handle and on par with live budder for potency.

9.desc:
Snow Cone is a terpene-rich hybrid led by limonene, backed by caryophyllene and myrcene, for a bright, sweet citrus top note with peppery spice over a smooth, earthy base.

Kind Tree Budder is crafted from fresh-frozen, premium indoor flower, preserving the true character of our signature cultivars. With a smooth, creamy texture and rich terpene expression, it delivers a flavorful concentrate rooted in the strains you know and trust from the Kind Tree garden.

This top-tier diamond concentrate showcases crystalline cannabinoid formations suspended in terpene-rich sauce, creating a potent and flavorful experience. The sweet, earthy, and gassy flavor profile offers a complex taste journey that cannabis connoisseurs will appreciate. Whether you're unwinding after a long day or seeking creative inspiration, this hybrid extract delivers consistent, hard-hitting results that showcase the art of concentrate craftsmanship.

14.desc: Bursting with notes of tropical candy, citrus zest, and a hint of creamy berry, this kief delivers a mouthwatering aroma that lives up to its name. Its hybrid genetics provide a balanced high — starting with a bright, euphoric head rush that enhances mood and focus, then easing into a mellow, body-soothing calm. Perfect for daytime creativity or a relaxing evening vibe.

15.desc:
PayDaze kief brings a potent, terp-rich upgrade to your bowl, joint, or blunt. Sifted from premium flower, this golden, powdery concentrate packs all the strain’s signature flavor—sweet citrus, creamy notes, and a hint of earthy spice—into a smooth, easily sprinkled form.
Expect a fast-acting lift that hits with a bright, euphoric buzz followed by a warm, relaxing body melt. Perfect for boosting potency or adding an extra layer of flavor to your favorite smoke, PayDaze kief delivers a clean, powerful, and deliciously enhanced experience with every sprinkle.

16.desc:
Pyramid Live Resin Molotov Cocktail is a premium, high-potency cannabis concentrate product. Produced by Pyramid, it is crafted from small-batch, top-tier fresh frozen material using high-quality hydrocarbon extraction to maximize terpene preservation.

The Molotov Cocktail strain features fuel-forward genetics, delivering a loud, gassy, and slightly sweet flavor with an energetic and explosive edge. Because Pyramid uses 100% single-source, strain-specific cannabis extractions without any added botanical or synthetic terpenes, the vapor provides a true-to-strain flavor that mimics a fresh harvest.

Users typically report a balanced high that feels calming and relaxed while maintaining a happy, clear-headed energy.

17.desc:
Pyramid’s Modified Banana Pebbles Live Resin is a premium concentrate extracted using high-quality hydrocarbons from fresh-frozen, small-batch cannabis flower. Freezing the flower immediately after harvest preserves a rich terpene profile and provides potent, authentic effects.

Breakdown & Profile

• Strain Type: Typically classified as a balanced Hybrid (though some concentrate batches are labeled with an Indica dominance due to the heavy relaxation effects).

• Genetics: A cross between Fruity Pebbles OG (FPOG) and Modified Banana.

18.desc:
Orange Tangie brings bright, juicy citrus with fresh orange, sweet tang, and a little skunky earthiness underneath. The effects start with an uplifting, feel-good buzz that brings some energy and positivity before settling into a relaxed, easygoing finish. Fresh, zesty, and cheerful, it's a fun choice when you want something bright without feeling too heavy.

Grower: Pantheon Cultivation

A layered, euphoric cultivar that opens with a buoyant cerebral rush before easing into a measured, full-body warmth. 22.desc:

Users can expect a balanced high that promotes creativity and energy, coupled with a happy and uplifting mood. Gyat is designed to enhance daytime activities, making it ideal for social gatherings or creative endeavors.

Flavor Profile: A sweet, dessert-like mixture of tart lemon, rich cherries, and a creamy, slightly gassy finish.

27.desc:
Lemon G X Dosidos

The Vision is a hybrid strain. It combines genetics from the classic Ohio Lemon G, famous for her strong lemon peel and Christmas wreath flavor, and the resinous, award-winning Do-Si-Dos. This strain was created as a testament to the vision of a brighter future through the propagation and cultivation of quality cannabis.

28.desc:
Garlic Ice Cream (GIC) is a popular, slightly indica-dominant hybrid strain bred from GMO and Dosidos. High Grass Farms, based in Buena, NJ, grows the flower for this cultivar.

Aroma/Flavor: This cultivar is often described as having a pungent, savory blend of herbal garlic and citrusy vanilla blended with sweet cream and diesel undertones.

Effects: Users typically report a slow onset that provides a euphoric mood boost before settling into full-bodied physical relaxation.

29.desc: The Rosin King of Jersey Push Pop 1G Cold Cured Live Rosin is a premium, solventless concentrate known for its smooth texture, high terpene retention, and robust flavor. The Push Pop strain typically offers a balanced hybrid experience.

Mint Granita brings cool mint, sweet herbal notes, creamy earth, and a touch of citrus for a smooth, flavorful dab. The balanced hybrid effects offer clear-headed uplift with gentle body relaxation, making it a versatile option for day or night.

Expect sweet citrus, tropical fruit, and earthy Kush notes with a smooth, aromatic finish. This balanced hybrid delivers an uplifting, euphoric effect with comfortable body relaxation, making it a versatile choice for any time of day.

Combining a fast-finishing Sour-Band (Sour Diesel x Headband) mother and Lucky Dog’s Chemdog 91 Bx3 from original Chemdog lineage, the Chem Fuego line offers robust genetics, with both parents promising pronounced and distinct flavor profiles, in addition to hashing potential. Effects vary by time of day and your own energy levels. Chem Fuego can uplift and sharpen focus or provide body relaxation at the end of the day.

Dr. Funkenstein, also known as "Dr. Funk," is an indica-dominant hybrid strain cultivated by Royal King Seeds. Born from the legendary union of Blueberry and Bubba Kush, this strain captures the best qualities of its renowned parentage. Dr. Funkenstein offers a flavorful journey that delights the palate with a blend of sweet berry notes and earthy sharpness, reflecting its rich genetic heritage.

The strain's primary terpene profile includes Myrcene, Pinene, and Caryophyllene, contributing to its distinctive flavors and effects. Myrcene enhances the sweet, fruity aroma and promotes a sense of relaxation. Pinene introduces subtle pine undertones that can uplift and refresh the senses, while Caryophyllene adds a spicy hint that elevates the overall taste experience. This harmonious combination results in a flavor profile featuring berry, blueberry, cheesy, and sweet notes that make each encounter with Dr. Funkenstein uniquely enjoyable.

Dr. Funkenstein is celebrated for inducing a multifaceted experience that pleasantly envelops both mind and body. Users often report an onset of euphoria and cerebral stimulation, fostering feelings of happiness and creativity. As the journey continues, it gradually transitions into a powerful body sensation that promotes deep relaxation and a laid-back state. This progression may lead to increased appetite and a gentle inclination toward introspection, accompanied by a soothing, sleepy feeling. Drawing from its Blueberry and Bubba Kush lineage, Dr. Funkenstein offers a well-rounded experience that balances uplifting mental effects with calming physical relaxation.

Strain Type: Hybrid
Lineage: [Blueberry] x [Bubba Kush]
Breeder: Royal King Seeds
Primary Terpene Profile: Myrcene, Pinene, Caryophyllene
Top Reported Strain Effects: Happy, Creative, Hungry, Sleepy, Euphoric
Top Reported Strain Flavors: Berry, Blueberry, Cheesy, Sweet, Earthy

161.desc:
Ghost OG, a cut of OG Kush, is a hybrid strain loved for its balanced cerebral and body effects.  Often described as simultaneously potent and non-intrusive, Ghost OG has won itself Cup awards and renown among consumers. 

Despite its intimidating name, Ghost OG is actually a mellow, relaxing strain that’s great for recreational use. This is the strain to go to when you’re having a Netflix-and-Chill day at home. As an indica-dominant hybrid, Ghost OG can melt all your worries, stressors, and anxieties away and replace them with a soothing, peaceful experience. There’s nothing better than watching your favorite comedy or listening to your favorite album than with Ghost OG in the mix.

Even though the high of Ghost OG is noticeable, it’s rarely considered to be too overpowering or overwhelming. This hybrid comes with moderate THC levels that are suitable for all smoking levels. The overall experience of Ghost OG is zen, euphoric, and giggly. This hybrid produces a happy high that veers on the cerebral side in the early stages.

The second wave of Ghost OG shows its indica side. The brain and body enter a state of pure relaxation. This can help combat feelings of pain, anxiety, nausea, and inflammation. Any discomfort in the body with gradually fade away as you continue to smoke Ghost OG on the couch. It also might be a good idea to keep snacks around as this strain promotes the munchies.

The Black Maple strain is a unique hybrid strain that combines the genetic traits of the Dulce De Uva and Sherbanger strains. As a hybrid variety, it has inherited qualities from both its parent strains, resulting in a unique genetic makeup that gives it distinct features, effects, and characteristics.

Dulce De Uva, a cross of Grape Pie and OG Kush, is cherished for its sweet, grape-like scent and deeply relaxing stone. Sherbanger, the other parent of Black Maple, is known for its rich, creamy flavor and dense, frosty buds. By combining the two, Bloom Seeds has created a stellar hybrid that embodies all the qualities of an elite strain.

The flavor of this strain is just as delightful, coating the mouth with the sweet flavors of blueberry ice cream and exotic spices. The taste lingers for several minutes, making for a pleasant experience that any cannabis user is sure to love.

163.desc:
Animal Star Cookies is a balanced hybrid strain expertly crafted by Greenpoint Seeds, born from the union of Animal Cookies and Stardawg. This unique blend combines the soothing qualities of an indica with the uplifting effects of a sativa, offering a gentle yet powerful experience that calms the body and elevates the spirit. With its harmonious nature, Animal Star Cookies helps users relax and find themselves in a state of emotional well-being.
The strain's rich terpene profile contributes to its complex flavors and effects. Sweet and earthy notes are complemented by hints of vanilla and nutty undertones, creating a delightful and nuanced taste experience. The presence of Limonene adds a subtle citrus zest, while Linalool imparts gentle floral accents. These terpenes enhance not only the flavor but also promote a calming and uplifting mood.
Drawing from its parent genetics, Animal Star Cookies inherits the full-body relaxation characteristic of Animal Cookies and the mood-enhancing properties of Stardawg. Users often report feelings of tranquility and happiness, with a gentle elevation of mood that eases away stress and encourages a positive mindset. This balanced hybrid is ideal for those seeking to unwind while maintaining a sense of alertness and emotional well-being.

The Hawaiian-bred Skunkdog Bx1, a staple strain on the islands, is known for its ability to withstand high humidity and thrive in even the wettest climates. This powerhouse male amplifies the acrid funk of Headband and ChemD and adds hardiness to the cross. While the flowering time runs longer than average, the payoff is worth the wait – a potent, complex expression of sour, skunk, and chem exploding from every bud.

189.desc:
Ice Cream Nana x Strawberry Runtz

-------------

This strain is part of Breakwater's Pheno Hunt project. Short for “Phenotype Hunt,” a Pheno Hunt is the search for the best possible version of a strain. When we acquire seeds of a compelling strain, we grow multiple plants to maturity. Each plant is a unique physical expression or phenotype of its genetic makeup (just like children from the same parents can be quite different). We evaluate each phenotype for traits such as flower size, plant structure, aromas, effects, and potency. In a successful Pheno Hunt, the most promising candidate will become a mother plant for a new strain of Breakwater Premium Flower.

With this new patient-facing project, we're inviting you to participate in this process and give us your feedback on which pheno is the best fit for our patients!

If you like strains that feel modern, flavorful, and easy to enjoy, Yoshi fits that lane well. It sounds like one of Pete’s Farmstand’s more approachable options: less pine-and-diesel, more sweet smoke, smooth vibes, and a steady hybrid finish.

In terms of effects, Jersey Runtz is often described as balanced and enjoyable, starting with an upbeat, happy headspace before easing into a calm, relaxed body feel. It can be a good choice for people who want something flavorful and smooth without feeling overly heavy too soon.

Effects: Offers a functional, daytime, creative high. It balances a cerebral euphoric burst with soothing body relaxation without immediate sedation.

229.desc: ROSIN TECH LABS presents Oklahoma Oreoz Hash Nugs, a premium infused flower experience in a convenient 3.5g format. This hybrid delivers the best of both worlds, combining balanced effects that inspire creativity and relaxation in equal measure. Each nug is expertly infused with quality hash, elevating potency and flavor beyond traditional flower. Expect rich, earthy aromas with sweet, creamy notes reminiscent of cookies and cream, complemented by subtle diesel undertones. Perfect for experienced consumers seeking enhanced effects, this infused flower provides a smooth, flavorful smoke with long-lasting euphoria and full-body relaxation. Whether unwinding after a long day or sparking creative inspiration, Oklahoma Oreoz delivers a sophisticated cannabis experience that showcases ROSIN TECH LABS' commitment to quality craftsmanship and innovation in infused products.

230.desc:
It all starts with premium indoor Kind Tree flower, the same whole nugs that you already know and love. We carefully spray each nug with distillate oil to achieve 20% coverage and put a good base layer to adhere the THCa powder isolate. Then we apply a 15% coverage of THCa powder to give the nugs the frosty, snowy look, inspiring the name "Snowballs".

Crack one open to find a lush green nug inside.

Quench your thirst for blissful relaxation with Cherry Slushee! This tantalizing Hybrid blends the iconic Cherry AK47 with the refreshing Kushmints, creating a flavor fusion bursting with cherry sweetness, zesty lime, and a hint of spicy kick. Dive into a wave of calming serenity that energizes the senses, making Cherry Slushee your perfect pick for unwinding after a long day or boosting creativity during a laid-back afternoon brainstorm session.

231.desc: Sour Apricot is a fast-acting, hybrid famous for its "one-hit-quit" potency. It delivers an uplifting cerebral rush followed by deep, giggly physical relaxation. It is highly sought-after for easing stress, depression, and minor pain.

232.desc:
Blue Nerdz is a hybrid from Global Genetics LA that brings Lemon Cherry Gelato and Zkittles genetics together. This strain delivers a nostalgic flavor profile—sweet candy notes that dominate the palate with slight gassy undertones keeping it grounded.

Effects might offer that playful balance between mental energy and body ease. Many people appreciate how this one brings back those carefree vibes while still delivering quality effects, though it hits everyone different. The Lemon Cherry Gelato genetics contribute that dessert-like smoothness, while Zkittles adds its signature fruity candy twist to the mix.

This hybrid connects with those who want flavors that bring out their inner kid and effects that keep things fun but satisfying. It's like candy store nostalgia with some grown-up appeal—a strain that makes any session feel like a treat for those looking to add some sweetness to their rotation.

233.desc: Gunpowder Milkshake is a unique hybrid strain that combines bold, earthy flavors with creamy sweetness. It offers a relaxing yet uplifting experience, making it ideal for unwinding without being overly sedating. The strain’s smooth, creamy smoke with a hint of spice is perfect for those seeking a flavorful and balanced high. Tastes: Earthy, creamy, sweet, with a touch of spice Effects: Relaxing, uplifting, calming

234.desc: PK Crasher is a potent hybrid strain that results from crossing Pure Kush with Wedding Crasher. This strain boasts a complex aroma profile of spicy, peppery, and citrus notes, thanks to its dominant terpenes, caryophyllene, limonene, myrcene, and linalool. PK Crasher is known for its calming and relaxing effects that can also provide a boost of energy. This strain can help users relieve stress, anxiety, and depression, and improve their sleep quality. PK Crasher is ideal for nighttime use and can provide a peaceful and restful sleep. Lineage: Pure Kush x Wedding Crasher Top Effects: Emotional Relief, Sleep, Calming Aroma: Spicy, Pepper, Citrus Top Terpenes: Caryophyllene, Limonene, Myrcene, Linalool

235.desc:
The strain was first introduced to the market amid a wave of interest in purple-colored weed strains, which had gained traction as a symbol of both beauty and high potency. Grape Rips offers an aroma that is both complex and deeply inviting, making it a delightful sensory experience even before consumption. The dominant scent profile carries unmistakable hints of sweet grapes with subtle undertones of earthy musk and berry.

At the onset, the strain is known to induce euphoria, characterized by heightened mental clarity and an elevated mood. This phase is typically marked by an immediate burst of creative energy, making it suitable for social settings and creative endeavors.

As the high deepens, users begin to experience profound physical relaxation, which is reflective of the strain’s indica heritage. Medical users have noted that this shift can be particularly beneficial for relieving muscle tension, chronic pain, and stress-related symptoms.

236.desc: The Strain: Max AC stands as a pinnacle of hybrid ingenuity, brought to life by Greenpoint Genetics through an inspired cross of MAC 1 and Animal Cookies. This strain captures the essence of two powerhouse genetics, blending the resin-rich, robust character of MAC 1 with the flavor-forward, distinctive profile of Animal Cookies. The result is a hybrid that delivers a compelling fusion of clear headed euphoria and soothing physical calm, tailored for those seeking both mental spark and grounded relaxation. The flavor profile of Max AC is a journey in complexity and depth. It opens with a bright citrus burst provided by limonene, delivering an immediate zing that awakens the senses. The spicy, peppery nuances of caryophyllene interlace with the rich, earthy foundation of myrcene and humulene, creating a multi-layered taste that is both robust and satisfying. Bisabolol rounds out the experience with subtle floral hints, adding an elegant softness that completes the symphony of flavors. The result is an immersive, gourmet experience that dances between tangy citrus, spicy earthiness, and delicate floral sweetness. As the high unfolds, Max AC sets the stage for a state of inspired focus and tranquil contentment. The initial rush sparks an elevated mood, fueling creative thoughts and a sense of invigorated drive ideal for sketching out new ideas or engaging in reflective planning. Gradually, a soothing calm pervades the body, nurturing a feeling of quiet satisfaction and mental clarity. Max AC's dynamic progression from an energizing lift to a serene, grounding calm invites you to embrace an active, yet reflective state, transforming your day into an exploration of both creative vibrancy and peaceful repose.Strain Type: Hybrid Lineage: [Mac 1] x [Animal Cookies] Breeder: Greenpoint Genetics Primary Terpene Profile: Caryophyllene, Limonene, Humulene, Myrcene, Bisabolol Top Reported Strain Effects: Calm, Contented, Motivated, Uplifted, Peaceful Top Reported Strain Flavors: Citrus, Creamy, Spicy, Earthy, Herbal, Floral

This powerhouse strain balances sweet and savory notes, blending sour, fuel-like aromas with hints of rich terpenes. Known for its lasting, full-bodied high, it provides a smooth yet intense cerebral and physical experience.

247.desc: EXOTICA GARDENS presents GALACTIC BOOM, a premium hybrid flower that delivers an otherworldly cannabis experience. This 3.5g pre-pack combines the best of both indica and sativa genetics, offering a balanced effect profile that's perfect for any time of day. GALACTIC BOOM entices the senses with its complex aroma featuring notes of sweet, earthy, and fruity undertones that translate into a smooth, flavorful smoke. Users report feeling uplifted and creative while maintaining a relaxed body sensation, making this hybrid ideal for socializing, creative projects, or simply unwinding after a long day. The carefully cured buds showcase vibrant colors and rich trichome coverage, reflecting EXOTICA GARDENS' commitment to quality cultivation. Whether you're seeking euphoric mental clarity or gentle physical relaxation, GALACTIC BOOM strikes the perfect cosmic balance in this convenient 3.5g package.

248.desc: EXOTICA GARDENS presents Purple Rain, a premium hybrid flower that delivers the perfect balance of mind and body effects. This 3.5g pre-pack showcases dense, purple-hued buds with a captivating aroma profile blending sweet berry notes with earthy undertones and a hint of floral lavender. Purple Rain offers a well-rounded experience that begins with an uplifting, euphoric cerebral buzz, gradually transitioning into gentle full-body relaxation. Ideal for those seeking creative inspiration while maintaining a sense of calm, this hybrid cultivar appeals to both recreational and wellness-focused consumers. The smooth, flavorful smoke features fruity sweetness on the inhale with subtle spicy notes on the exhale. Whether unwinding after a long day or enhancing social gatherings, Purple Rain provides consistent quality and effects that hybrid enthusiasts appreciate. Expertly cultivated and carefully cured to preserve terpenes and cannabinoids for maximum potency and flavor.

249.desc: CRAFT KINGS delivers premium cannabis with their Royal Smalls Candy Cut, a perfectly cured 3.5g hybrid flower that balances the best of both worlds. This pre-pack showcases dense, resinous buds with a sweet, fruity aroma reminiscent of candy with subtle earthy undertones. The Candy Cut strain offers a well-rounded experience, combining uplifting cerebral effects with soothing body relaxation—ideal for daytime creativity or evening unwinding. Expect flavors of sweet berries and tropical fruit on the inhale, finishing with smooth, herbal notes. Whether you're seeking focus for projects or simply want to feel happy and relaxed, this hybrid delivers consistent, quality effects. CRAFT KINGS' Royal Smalls line provides craft-quality cannabis in a convenient size, perfect for sampling premium strains without commitment. Elevate your flower game with this flavorful, balanced hybrid.

250.desc: A sweet, fruity hybrid with notes of candy, berries, and citrus. Space Candy delivers an uplifting, euphoric experience paired with a smooth, relaxing finish—great for sparking creativity and keeping the mood light.

251.desc: Harvest Moon Farms "Fire Fumez" (3.5g) is a premium New Jersey craft hybrid cannabis strain that delivers a balanced, potent high starting with an energetic, creative head buzz before settling into a deeply relaxing, couch-lock body calm. The strain is highly regarded for its intense "candy gas" profile, combining a pungent aroma of sweet tropical fruit and sugared berries with a sharp, heavy finish of sour diesel and spicy pepper. Dominated by terpenes like Limonene, Caryophyllene, and Myrcene.

252.desc: Cheeba Cake by TICAL is a hard-hitting hybrid cannabis strain that delivers a smooth, dessert-like experience with a distinct sweet, creamy, and doughy aroma accented by earthy, herbal undertones. As a true hybrid, it offers a well-balanced high that starts with an immediate burst of euphoric happiness and mental clarity, which gradually settles into a soothing physical relaxation that melts away bodily tension. Because it provides deep stress relief without causing immediate drowsiness, it makes for an incredibly versatile "anytime" smoke perfect for both creative solo sessions and casual social gatherings.

253.desc: GREEN LIGHTNING presents Don Shula, a balanced hybrid flower that delivers the best of both worlds. This expertly cultivated strain offers a harmonious blend of uplifting and relaxing effects, making it perfect for any time of day. Don Shula greets you with an inviting aroma profile featuring earthy and herbal notes complemented by subtle fruity undertones. Each bud is carefully selected and packaged to preserve freshness and potency. Whether you're seeking creative inspiration, social energy, or gentle relaxation, this hybrid flower adapts to your needs. The 3.5g size provides excellent value for both newcomers and seasoned enthusiasts looking to explore GREEN LIGHTNING's premium quality. Experience the winning combination of flavor, effects, and craftsmanship with Don Shula.

255.desc:
Gorilla Pie is a perfectly balanced hybrid strain born from the exceptional cross of Gorilla Glue #4 and Jelly Pie. This unique blend offers a harmonious fusion of effects and flavors that cater to both indica and sativa enthusiasts. The high from Gorilla Pie begins a few minutes after consumption, filling the mind with an uplifting sense of happiness and ease. Users often report an intense euphoria accompanied by increased sociability and creativity, making it an excellent choice for social gatherings or artistic endeavors.

The flavor profile of Gorilla Pie is as delightful as its effects. It offers a super sweet and fruity grape pie taste, accented by hints of black pepper and diesel on the exhale. The aroma mirrors this complexity, featuring a fruity berry overtone complemented by spicy herbs and a peppery, dank diesel finish. This rich palette of flavors is attributed to its primary terpene profile, which includes Myrcene, Limonene, Caryophyllene, Linalool, and Terpineol. These terpenes contribute not only to its distinctive taste and smell but also enhance the overall experience by influencing its calming and uplifting effects.

Drawing from its parent genetics, Gorilla Pie inherits the euphoric and creative effects of Jelly Pie and the relaxing qualities of Gorilla Glue #4. Users may find themselves bursting into laughter, as the strain can induce a joyful and carefree mood. The combination of mental stimulation and physical relaxation provides a balanced experience that eases tension while keeping the mind engaged. Gorilla Pie is ideal for those seeking a strain that offers both a blissful cerebral high and a soothing body sensation, making it versatile for various occasions and times of day.

256.desc:
Brute's Roots "Blue Lobzter" 3.5g is a premium, indica-dominant hybrid cannabis flower cultivated and distributed across recreational dispensaries in New Jersey. This award-winning strain is a rare cross between Apples N Bananas and Eye Candy, originally popularized by Maine Trees and bred by Chris Lynch.

Strain Profile & Characteristics

• Lineage: Apples N Bananas x Eye Candy
• Type: Indica-Dominant Hybrid
• Potency & Terpenes: Batches from Brute's Roots typically test quite high, showing around 32.9% THC and 2.14% Terpenes.
• Appearance: Dense, resinous emerald buds featuring deep blue and purple undertones, heavily frosted in trichomes and accented by fiery orange hairs—resembling a unique "lobster shell" aesthetic.
• Aroma & Flavor: A complex "fruity gas" profile. It leads with a sweet, sugary blueberry candy and grape flavor, followed by hints of tart green apples, creamy undertones, and a smooth citrus/gassy finish.

Effects & Experience

The strain hits quickly, delivering a soaring, euphoric mental high that boosts mood and creativity. This is followed closely by a deep, calming physical relaxation that settles across the body, easing tension without immediately locking you to the couch. It is highly regarded as a great late-afternoon or evening strain for unwinding or socializing.

257.desc: Purple Pressure by Hugh Douglas is a highly potent hybrid strain that delivers a loud aroma of sweet citrus, cinnamon-coated orange, pungent diesel, and woody pine. On the palate, it offers a smooth, doughy flavor marked by sour citrus and a spicy pepper-vanilla exhale. The effects hit quickly, starting with an uplifting, euphoric cerebral buzz that promotes happiness and chattiness before transitioning into a deeply relaxing body wave that melts away physical tension, making it a popular choice for relieving chronic stress, anxiety, and inflammation.

258.desc: The Happy Farmer "Grand Scarlet Jelly" (3.5g) is a premium hybrid cannabis strain known for its sweet, fruit-forward profile that smells intensely of ripe berries, sugary fruit preserves, and doughy, cream-like undertones. Driven by dominant terpenes like myrcene, limonene, and caryophyllene, it delivers a balanced, multi-stage experience that begins with a bright, euphoric cerebral lift to dissolve mental stress. This initial high smoothly transitions into a deeply soothing body relaxation that melts muscular tension away without causing heavy, immediate sedation, making it an excellent choice for late afternoon decompression, creative unwinding, or social evenings.

259.desc:
Blueprint’s Chef is a flavorful hybrid flower in a premium 3.5g format, built from Zoap BX1 genetics and known for its euphoric, social character.

Expect a lively mix of sweet candy, funky gas, and bright floral notes, accented by hints of lavender. The terpene profile balances sugary sweetness with savory funk and a soft floral finish for a layered, aromatic smoke.

Chef brings an upbeat, euphoric experience with a social-friendly vibe, making it a great choice for sharing with friends, creative moments, or simply enjoying a flavorful hybrid session.

260.desc: Blockberry is an evenly balanced hybrid strain created by crossing Black Cherry Punch and Tropicanna Cookies F2. Best known for its highly sought-after phenotype Superboof, it features a complex flavor profile of sharp tropical berries, zesty citrus candy, and smooth vanilla funk. It delivers a versatile experience that begins with a bright, creative cerebral uplift before transitioning into a deeply relaxing body high that avoids heavy couch-lock. For cultivators, the strain is highly prized for its vibrant purple and autumn coloration, massive yields, and exceptional suitability for hash production.

261.desc: "Pink Ink" by The Cut is a premium, trichome-heavy hybrid cannabis strain bred from a cross of Permanent Marker and Spritzer. Cultivated and distributed primarily in the New Jersey market, it typically boasts a potent profile dominated by the terpenes limonene, beta-caryophyllene, and linalool. This composition delivers a unique sensory contrast, blending the sweet, chalky flavor of pink hard candies and berries with a pungent, gassy diesel undertone. Users generally experience an initial upbeat, creative head buzz that smoothly transitions into a deeply relaxing, euphoric body high.

262.desc: Grown Rogue Lantz (3.5g) delivers a complex aromatic profile defined by a sharp contrast of sweet tart candy and rich citrus layered over a heavy, pungent diesel and pine gas undertone. The experience begins with an immediate uplifting cerebral buzz that sharpens focus and sparks creativity, making it a great choice for social settings or creative projects. Over time, this energetic onset smoothly transitions into a deeply grounding physical relaxation that relieves muscle tension without causing overwhelming sedation. Because of this balanced, dual-stage effect, consumers frequently look to this strain for late-afternoon or evening use to help manage stress, anxiety, and insomnia.

263.desc:
Star Killer is a potent indica-dominant strain prized for its deeply relaxing effects, pungent aroma, and rich, earthy flavor profile. A cross of Skywalker OG and Rare Dankness #2, Star Killer delivers dense, resin-coated buds with vibrant green hues, fiery orange pistils, and a frosty blanket of trichomes. It's an excellent choice for evening sessions when you're ready to unwind and leave the day's stress behind.

The experience begins with a gentle cerebral calm that eases racing thoughts before transitioning into a heavy, soothing body relaxation. As the effects build, users often report a tranquil, sedating finish that makes Star Killer ideal for quiet nights, movie marathons, or preparing for restful sleep.

It has a balanced high that is both relaxing and euphoric, with a pleasant body buzz and a creative mind. Kush Mints effects include feeling relaxed, euphoric, and aroused. Medical marijuana patients often choose Kush Mints when dealing with symptoms associated with anxiety, stress, and depression. Kush Mints features flavors like mint, menthol, and pine. The dominant terpene of this strain is limonene.

Cali Cake's hybrid nature offers versatile effects that inspire creativity and euphoria while maintaining a soothing body calm, making it ideal for both daytime focus and evening unwind sessions. The rich, dessert-like flavor profile delivers smooth, indulgent smoke with hints of spice and subtle citrus on the exhale. Perfect for cannabis enthusiasts seeking craft-quality flower with sophisticated terpene expression and well-rounded effects. Whether you're looking to enhance social experiences or simply enjoy a flavorful, relaxing session, this 7 gram offering provides exceptional value and quality from a trusted craft cannabis brand.

Its reported experience begins with a tingly body buzz and a gentle mood lift before settling into deeper body relaxation and a calm, mellow headspace. For fans of funky, minty flower with plenty of character, Governmint Oasis is worth exploring.

Mochi Melon
Zkittlez x Watermelon Zkittlez x Mochi

This hybrid delivers a silky-smooth ride — fruity, floral, and slightly funky — with a euphoric lift and mellow physical ease. Expect vibrant buds kissed with trichomes and bursting with terpene-rich complexity.

The result is a complex, fruit-forward smoke that balances juicy peach and candy notes with deeper fuel, earth, and floral undertones. Expect a resin-heavy experience with a smooth, layered flavor that develops from sweet and tropical into more pungent, gassy territory. The effects are deeply satisfying, beginning with a bright sense of euphoria before settling into a relaxed, full-bodied calm.

273.desc:
Permanent Gas
Sour Diesel × Permanent Marker

Permanent Gas hits hard and lingers long — a sharp, fuel-soaked inhale followed by a funky, floral funk on the exhale. This hybrid balances Sour Diesel’s electrifying clarity with Permanent Marker’s deep musk and creamy undertone. Expect a gassy, loud nose, sticky resin-rich buds, and a smooth slide from uplift to sedation. It’s a heavy hybrid built for seasoned smokers who want their weed to talk back.

274.desc:
The Jet Fuel high smashes into you with an immediate effect felt right in the forehead and behind the eyes. You'll feel euphoric and uplifted with a sense of tingly cerebral energy that can leave you super giggly at times. As your mind soars through the clouds, your body will succumb to a feeling of complete relaxation that doesn't cause sedation or couch-lock, but rather leaves you incredibly lazy.

Amidst life's ups and downs, there's a special feeling that makes your heart skip with joy. That's Springtime - a place where happiness finds you in the little things. Imagine waking up to a lousy day, but a single sip of the finest coffee brings a smile to your lips, or like a warm ray of sunshine, that bathes you in comfort, filling you with happiness from the inside.

275.desc: Hawaiian Rain is a hybrid cannabis strain derived from London Pound Mints and Jealousy. It is typically distributed in measured quantities and is characterized by distinct botanical features, including purple and green coloration with trichome coverage. The strain possesses a terpene profile that produces aromas reminiscent of berries, lavender, and citrus. Its consumption is associated with psychoactive effects that transition from initial cerebral stimulation to physical sedation, which may cause drowsiness.

276.desc:
Berry Bomb: The terpene profile of this Berry Bomb may offer a deeply calming, body-centered experience that leans toward rest.

Myrcene leads the profile, with an earthy, ripe-mango aroma. It is often associated with a heavy, soothing sense of physical relaxation that could help you settle in for the evening.

ß-Caryophyllene follows with a warm, peppery spice, like black pepper. It is the one terpene known to interact with the body's cannabinoid receptors, and it may help soften physical tension and discomfort.

Linalool adds a soft, lavender-like floral note. It may quiet a busy mind and encourage a peaceful headspace that supports winding down.

Ocimene brings a sweet, herbal brightness found in orchids and basil, and it has long been valued in perfumery. It may add a gentle lift to balance the deeper notes.

a-Humulene contributes a woody, earthy depth and shares its origins with brewing hops. It may support full-body comfort, and it is also noted for its purported appetite-suppressing effect.

Rounding out the profile are limonene, the citrus-rind note that could brighten the mood; nerolidol, found in jasmine and tea tree; ß-pinene, found in rosemary and parsley; terpineol, with its lilac-like scent; fenchol, found in basil and fennel; valencene, named for the Valencia orange; a-bisabolol, also found in chamomile; and a-pinene, the scent of pine needles.

277.desc:

Spicy beta-caryophyllene from black pepper may interact with body receptors to help softly soothe physical stress and ground the energetic mood.

Woodsy alpha-humulene, sharing genetic origins with traditional brewing hops, could softly support full-body comfort as you relax into a good laugh, and may even suppress your appetite!

Grounding myrcene, abundant in sweet mangoes, might introduce a soft layer of physical ease to keep the experience wonderfully balanced.

Finally, woody beta-pinene, present in fresh rosemary and parsley, could support active mental clarity and subtle cognitive focus to keep your thoughts bright.

Dominant beta-caryophyllene, present in black pepper, may interact with body receptors to help softly soothe physical tension and support deep bodily relaxation.

Woodsy alpha-humulene, sharing genetic origins with traditional brewing hops, might softly support full-body comfort as you unwind into ease as well as reduce appetite.

Bright limonene from citrus rinds could elevate your mood, adding a splash of refreshing mental clarity to balance the heavy physical calm.

Sweet ocimene, present in orchids and basil and historically valued in fine European perfumery for its sweet floral aroma, might offer a light spark of creative motivation.

Rarely featured prominently, sabinene hydrate is an uncommon terpene naturally found in marjoram, oak, and carrot seed oil; historically used in soothing herbal tea preparations, it may encourage a serene and grounding sense of tranquility.

Finally, citrusy valencene, named after Valencia oranges where it naturally occurs and historically used as an aromatic pest deterrent, could promote a light sense of balanced harmony.

The strain's terpene profile features Limonene, Humulene, Nerolidol 2, Myrcene, and Pinene, contributing to its complex flavors and effects. Limonene imparts bright citrus notes that uplift the senses, while Myrcene adds earthy undertones promoting relaxation. Pinene introduces a refreshing pine aroma, enhancing alertness and focus. These terpenes create dominant flavors of sweet berries and strawberries, complemented by a strong, pungent diesel undertone inherited from its Strawberry Diesel parent.

Bruce Banner is known for its energizing and uplifting effects, making it an excellent choice for daytime use. Users often report high energy levels accompanied by heightened creativity and a euphoric mood. Drawing from its OG Kush lineage, it provides a balanced experience that relaxes the body without sedation, while the influence of Strawberry Diesel enhances motivation and happiness. It's described as offering a sweet and sugary taste with a hint of spice, and an aroma with citrus, cherry, and gassy diesel notes. The high is said to be both bright and soothing, with mental and physical effects.

328.desc:
Mintlato is a hybrid born of Animal Mints and Gelato 41, showcasing a terpene cast led by limonene, caryophyllene, humulene, myrcene, and pinene. At first draw, limonene brings a bright citrus zing that awakens the senses, while pinene’s fresh pine notes add a brisk clarity. Myrcene’s earthy, musky undertones lend a plush, soothing backdrop, and caryophyllene’s spicy warmth weaves through the mix, rounding out the flavor with a subtle peppery edge. Humulene’s herbal whisper ties everything together, creating a complex, mint-tinged profile that feels both crisp and luxuriant.

Onset is marked by a light uplift—limonene promotes a buoyant sense of optimism, lifting the spirit without racing the mind. As that initial glow settles, myrcene and humulene ease the body into gentle relaxation, melting away tension without heavy sedation. Pinene’s clarity helps maintain focus, keeping thoughts crisp even as a comfortable calm washes over you. The result is a balanced high that can fuel creative bursts, spark conversation, or simply enhance a lazy afternoon with a refreshing twist.

With its harmonious interplay of invigorating and soothing notes, Mintlato invites you to explore a variety of activities. Tackle a brainstorming session with newfound clarity, lose yourself in mellow music with a relaxed frame of mind, or savor a quiet moment of reflection as the minty breeze lingers on your palate - Mintlato adapts to your mood, amplifying joy and composure in equal measure.

329.desc:
**Diamond Infused**

Upon consumption, users experience a smooth exhale of sweet candy and peppery floral spice that triggers a multi-stage effect. It begins with an uplifting, euphoric head buzz that sparks creative energy and boosts mood, before gently transitioning into a soothing body relaxation that melts away physical tension and stress without causing heavy couch-lock, making it ideal for afternoon or evening unwinding.

Driven by a potent terpene profile including Beta-Caryophyllene and Myrcene, it delivers a versatile high that combines uplifting mental clarity with a deep, physical relaxation. Users frequently report feeling a harmonious blend of being calm, happy, relaxed, and gently energetic, making it an ideal choice for unwinding without experiencing heavy sedation.

Known for its potent effects, this hybrid delivers an invigorating high that energizes the mind while relaxing the body. Its dense, resin-coated buds boast a striking appearance, making it a feast for the eyes as well as the senses. Your companion for a nice uplift.

This variety balances the traits of its lineage: Moonbow introduces a bright, sweet fruitiness reminiscent of Zkittlez on the inhale, while Gorilla Glue #4 adds distinct notes of chemical, diesel, and earthy funk on the finish.

337.desc: Space Gems by Yeti (10-pack) is a 5-gram box of ten 0.5g cannabis pre-rolls. Its aroma blends peppery spice, bright citrus, and earthy pine notes, driven by a terpene profile led by beta-caryophyllene, limonene, and beta-myrcene. As a balanced hybrid, it delivers fast-acting, calm, and happy effects with gentle mental energy rather than heavy sedation.

338.desc:
The Cut Freaknik 10-Pack is a 5-gram multi-pack of ten 0.5-gram hybrid cannabis pre-rolls.

Key Highlights

• Potency & Terpenes. Delivers roughly 30.56% THC and 3.04% total terpenes, led by beta-caryophyllene (1.16%) and beta-myrcene (0.52%).

• Aroma & Flavor. Features a spicy, peppery, and earthy profile with subtle herbal and musky undertones driven by its dominant terpenes.

• Effects. Promotes a happy, uplifted mood paired with heavy physical relaxation and mental calm, making it suited for unwinding.

339.desc: Berry Bankroll by Yeti is a premium, high-potency Indica-dominant hybrid strain known for its deeply relaxing and sedating effects. Visually, the 3.5-gram eighths feature dense, chunky buds blanketed in a heavy layer of frosty trichomes with vibrant purple undertones and bright orange pistils. True to its name, it delivers a rich flavor profile dominated by sweet, juicy berries and ripe fruit, complemented by a sharp, pungent gas and earthy undertone on the exhale. Driven by a terpene profile rich in limonene, caryophyllene, and myrcene, it typically tests with a high THC percentage that produces a heavy, enveloping body buzz and strong mental euphoria. This makes it an ideal choice for evening use, managing stress, or melting away physical tension at the end of the day.

340.desc: Happy Hour is a hybrid weed strain made from a genetic cross between unknown parents. This strain is 50% sativa and 50% indica. Happy Hour is a festive and uplifting strain that has a sweet, earthy, fruity, and spicy flavor and aroma. This strain is best enjoyed during the day or when you need a burst of energy and fun.

341.desc: True to its name, Game Over comes through with heavy-hitting flavor and presence. This strain brings forward deep, gassy notes layered with earthy spice and a touch of sweet funk, creating a rich and unforgettable profile. Potent and full-bodied, it’s a knockout choice for those who like their smoke strong and flavorful.

Banana Pie infused prerolls take the rich, nostalgic taste of banana cream pie and elevate it with premium flower. Each preroll is infused with our signature Banana Pie terpene oil, blending the tropical sweetness of ripe bananas with waves of

As the experience settles, a soft sweetness lingers, leaving you in a contented, buoyant state. Banana Pie prerolls shine during leisurely afternoons spent with friends, quiet moments of inspiration, or simply whenever you’re craving a sweet pick-me-up.

Infused with our meticulously crafted terpene blends, these prerolls deliver a smooth, potent experience, powered by the purest cannabis oil. Using only the coldest methods and the highest quality flower, this golden oil is free from fillers,

The aroma takes things up about five levels, adding in layers of pungent dank, skunky sage and woody pine to the fruity and sugary blend. The Maple Root high will begin immediately, starting with a tingle felt in the extremities that is numbing and pleasant. This tingle will soon begin to ebb and flow throughout the rest of your body, hitting your body with deep relaxation and your mind with a sense of hazy, happy sedation that leaves you feeling super elated yet unable to focus.

Dill Weed delivers a balanced hybrid experience that pairs an uplifting mental presence with an easygoing sense of relaxation. 450.desc:
Lemon Tree Punch is a captivating hybrid strain crafted by Greenpoint Seeds, born from the flavorful cross of Lemon Tree and Purple Punch. This exceptional blend marries the sweet-and-sour zest of Lemon Tree with the fruity fragrance of Purple Punch, resulting in a rich and complex flavor profile. Strong notes of lemon, grape, and berry dominate the aroma, intertwined with subtle hints of diesel and earthy undertones. Depending on the phenotype, some expressions may highlight the grape and berry flavors, while others emphasize the citrusy essence, offering a unique experience with each taste.
The strain's primary terpenes include Limonene, Humulene, Myrcene, Linalool, and Bisabolol, contributing to its multifaceted flavors and effects. Limonene imparts a bright citrus flavor and is associated with uplifting mood and energy. Humulene and Myrcene add earthy and herbal nuances, promoting a sense of calm and relaxation. Linalool introduces gentle floral notes, enhancing the overall aromatic experience. Together, these terpenes create a harmonious balance that is both invigorating and soothing.
Lemon Tree Punch offers a balanced effect that is both stimulating and comforting. Users report that in small doses, it may boost mood and increase motivation, providing a gentle cerebral uplift that enhances focus and creativity. When consumed in larger quantities, the invigorating sensation shifts into a mellow relaxation, soothing the mind and fostering a peaceful state. Despite the calming body effects, the mind remains clear and functional. This versatile hybrid is ideal for those seeking to elevate their spirits during the day or unwind in the evening, making it a great all-day choice.

The Strain - Ghost OG, a cut of OG Kush, is a hybrid strain loved for its balanced cerebral and body effects. Often described as simultaneously potent and non-intrusive, Ghost OG has won itself Cup awards and renown among consumers.

Despite its intimidating name, Ghost OG is actually a mellow, relaxing strain that’s great for recreational use. This is the strain to go to when you’re having a Netflix-and-Chill day at home. As an indica-dominant hybrid, Ghost OG can melt all your worries, stressors, and anxieties away and replace them with a soothing, peaceful experience. There’s nothing better than watching your favorite comedy or listening to your favorite album than with Ghost OG in the mix.

Even though the high of Ghost OG is noticeable, it’s rarely considered to be too overpowering or overwhelming. This hybrid comes with moderate THC levels that are suitable for all smoking levels. The overall experience of Ghost OG is zen, euphoric, and giggly. This hybrid produces a happy high that veers on the cerebral side in the early stages.

The second wave of Ghost OG shows its indica side. The brain and body enter a state of pure relaxation. This can help combat feelings of pain, anxiety, nausea, and inflammation. Any discomfort in the body with gradually fade away as you continue to smoke Ghost OG on the couch. It also might be a good idea to keep snacks around as this strain promotes the munchies.

Limonene adds a citrusy zest, uplifting the overall aroma. Caryophyllene introduces a spicy kick, while Linalool offers subtle floral hints that enhance the sweetness. Geraniol further amplifies the fruity and floral characteristics, rounding out the sensory experience with its pleasant fragrance.

Violet Fog is known for its hazy and uplifting effects. Users often report a sense of unfocused happiness that can lead to lightheartedness and giggles. As the experience unfolds, a deep relaxation may settle in, promoting a calm and sleepy state. This combination of mood-enhancing and soothing effects makes Violet Fog an ideal choice for unwinding after a long day, offering a peaceful transition into a restful evening.

Limonene adds a citrusy zest, uplifting the overall aroma. Caryophyllene introduces a spicy kick, while Linalool offers subtle floral hints that enhance the sweetness. Geraniol further amplifies the fruity and floral characteristics, rounding out the sensory experience with its pleasant fragrance.

Violet Fog is known for its hazy and uplifting effects. Users often report a sense of unfocused happiness that can lead to lightheartedness and giggles. Hibernate is a potent indica strain meticulously crafted by the master breeders at Greenpoint Seeds, born from the cross of Shut Eye and Stardawg. This unique blend brings together an impressive lineage that includes Fire OG, Bubba Kush, Alien Technology, Purple Kush, and Chemdog. Hibernate lives up to its name by offering deeply relaxing and soothing effects, making it an ideal choice for those seeking tranquility and restful sleep. Its terpene profile features Nerolidol 2, Limonene, Humulene, Myrcene, and Bisabolol, all contributing to its distinctive flavor and calming properties.

The flavor profile of Hibernate leans toward earthy and woody notes, complemented by hints of pine and a strong lemon peel accent. Limonene adds a citrusy zest that brightens the overall taste, while Myrcene and Humulene contribute to the strain's herbal and earthy undertones. Bisabolol introduces subtle floral nuances, enhancing the complexity of the flavor. The aroma is equally captivating, with variations that include lemon tones, cherry, rock candy, and the skunky essence characteristic of Stardawg.

Drawing from its rich genetic background, Hibernate offers a profoundly relaxing and euphoric experience. Users often report feelings of deep calmness and serenity, with a gentle wave of sleepiness that envelops both mind and body. The influence of Shut Eye provides intensely soothing effects, while Stardawg adds a touch of uplifting euphoria. This harmonious blend makes Hibernate an excellent choice for unwinding after a long day, promoting a peaceful state of mind and preparing for a restful night's sleep.
