557.desc: White Truffle by Legend is an indica-dominant hybrid known for its calm, euphoric effects and rich, earthy flavor. A variant of the Gorilla Butter lineage, this strain hits quickly with a clear-headed lift that melts into deep physical relaxation. Its aroma mixes savory, nutty, and skunky notes, while the flavor reveals a smooth blend of earth and spice with subtle truffle-like richness. Ideal for evening use, White Truffle helps quiet the mind and ease tension, making it the perfect companion for unwinding after a long day.

558.desc: Taffy Twist by RYTHM is a flavorful indica-dominant strain crossed from Lomelo 18 and Sour Animal Cherries. It features a candy-like sweet and sour citrus profile with a sugary finish. Users typically experience a gentle mental uplift that transitions into relaxing, calming body effects perfect for evening unwinding

559.desc: A collab between Bloom Seed Co. and Boston Root Seed, Super Gremlin was created by crossing 09’ Animal Cookies x Sherbanger. With aromas of pungent earth, sweet herbs, and a sour overtone, Super Gremlin will be sure to leave you relaxed. Super Gremlin buds are deep green with dark purple tones and bright orange hairs, making this strain equally beautiful as it is enjoyable.

560.desc: Shaka's Frosted Truffle Pie 3.5g is a potent indica-dominant hybrid strain (Truffle Cake x Peach Pie). It delivers sweet, earthy, and chocolate aromas alongside heavy relaxing effects.

561.desc:
Aroma Profile

The strain features a loud, complex fragrance that fills a room quickly after grinding.

Primary Notes: A bright hit of sweet candied lemon peel mixed with tart, juicy maraschino cherries.

Undertones: A smooth, creamy vanilla soft-serve and sugar cookie finish.

Accents: Subtle traces of spicy black pepper, earthy pine, and a faint gassy twang on the backend.

Experiential Effects

This hybrid typically delivers a full-bodied effects that feel uplifted yet deeply relaxed.

Mental Onset: It hits quickly with a soaring wave of euphoria, clear-headed mental clarity, and creative energy.

Mood Shift: Expect a chatty, outgoing social window and a carefree attitude where stress melts away.

Physical Plateau: As the high settles, a warm body calm spreads to ease physical aches and muscle tension.

The Taper: It keeps you tranquil and content without immediate heavy couchlock,

562.desc:
Aroma and Flavor Profile

Bluephoria features a sweet, modern, dessert-inspired aroma profile:

Primary Scent: Sharp notes of ripe blueberry, mixed berries, and sugary candy dominate the fragrance when breaking apart the buds.

Undertones: The fruitiness is layered with hints of citrus zest and a smooth, creamy earthiness.

The Inhale/Exhale: Consumers note a highly flavorful, smooth smoke that tastes like sweet berry syrup with a subtle herbal finish.

563.desc:
Purple Starfruit

Tart and tangy with exotic fruit notes. Provides a creative yet calming buzz with indica grounding effects, making it suitable for late

afternoons and evenings.

Lineage & Terpenes: CakeMints/Platinum GSC × LilMissHS • Berry, earthy, herbal

564.desc:
Description

Gas Nana is a indica cultivar known for its bold fuel-forward aroma, dense structure, and heavy resin production. The flowers are typically tight and chunky, featuring deep green buds with occasional purple undertones, bright orange pistils, and a thick coating of frosty, sticky trichomes that reflect its rich terpene content.

Aroma & Flavor
Gas Nana is commonly described as offering a powerful blend of pungent diesel and earthy gas layered with sweet banana and ripe fruit. Subtle notes of creamy sweetness and light herbal spice add depth, creating a profile that balances tropical dessert tones with sharp fuel intensity. The flavor follows through with a smooth combination of sweet banana, creamy fruit, and a lingering gassy, earthy finish on the exhale.

Experience
Consumers often report a calm, mood-elevating onset followed by a steady wave of full-body relaxation. The effects are typically described as soothing and body-forward, supporting mental ease and physical comfort while maintaining a relaxed, functional state. Individual experiences may vary.

Typical Characteristics
Type: Indica

Primary Notes: Banana, sweet fruit, diesel, creamy earth

Reported Experience: Relaxed, uplifted, balanced calm

565.desc:
Cherry Mellow from Cookies is an indica-dominant hybrid celebrated for its rich flavor and potent effects. This strain is a cross between the popular Runtz and Funky Charms, combining the best traits of both to offer an incredibly flavorful experience. The flavor is often described as a delightful cherry marshmallow with a subtle hint of gas, creating a smooth and tasty smoke that appeals to those who enjoy sweet and dessert-like profiles.

Cherry Mellow boasts a robust terpene profile with notes of cherries, creamy cheesecake icing, earthy undertones, and a touch of gas. This complex aroma and flavor combination makes it uniquely satisfying and memorable. The effects of Cherry Mellow are primarily calming and relaxing, delivering a soothing body high that promotes happiness and uplifted mood, ideal for stress relief, anxiety reduction, and pain management. Users also report feeling focused yet mellow, making it versatile for both casual use and relaxation. While it may lead to some dry eyes or dizziness in rare cases, the overall experience is smooth and enjoyable, making Cherry Mellow a standout strain within the Cookies lineup for those seeking sweet flavor with mellow effects.

566.desc:
Jesus Shuttlesworth is a premium cannabis strain cultivated by Blueprint Cannabis Co., named after Ray Allen’s fictional basketball character in the movie He Got Game. It features an umami and gassy terpene profile with sweet, floral, and dark berry notes.

Strain Details

Grower: Blueprint Cannabis Co.

Type: Indica-dominant hybrid

Aroma & Taste: Umami, dark berries, floral sherbet, and gassy citrus

Top Terpenes: Limonene, Myrcene, Linalool

Effects: Deep relaxation, body calm, and a chill, euphoric vibe.

567.desc:
Blueprint P90 (3.5g) is a premium, indica-dominant cannabis flower heavily nicknamed the "Gas Man" due to its remarkably pungent, room-filling aroma. It is highly regarded for its top-tier indoor cultivation quality, resinous and sticky buds, and deeply sedative, heavy-hitting effects.

Strain Overview & Lineage

Lineage: P90 is a powerhouse cross between Gorilla Glue #4 (GG4) x Gelato 41, bringing together elite genetics that offer deep chemical, earthy, and sweet dessert qualities.

Appearance: Dense, hard, medium-sized light green buds layered with vibrant hues of violet and blue, completely coated in a heavy white layer of shimmering, resinous trichomes.

Aroma, Flavor, and Terpene Profile

The strain is famous for a "nose-burning funk" that combines traditional gassy undertones with unique flavor complexities:

Scent: A powerful infusion of skunk, diesel fuel, hazelnut, and chemicals, with a subtle menthol finish.

Taste: A clean, heavy inhale of gassy, creamy earthiness balanced by faint, sweet floral undertones on the exhale.

Dominant Terpenes: Testing reveals a profile heavily dominated by Beta-Caryophyllene, followed by Limonene, Linalool, and Humulene .

Experience & Effects

The High: Expect an immediate full-body melt that dissolves physical tension, creates "heavy eyes," and brings on a deeply tranquil state of mind.

Best Used For: Unwinding after a long day, managing physical aches, easing severe insomnia, or any evening routine dedicated to deep relaxation.

568.desc:
Triple Lindy is a award-winning premium hybrid cannabis strain bred by Blueprint Cannabis Co. that achieved major acclaim by winning Best Overall and Most Potent at the 2022 Winter Zalympix competition. Named after the famous impossible dive from the movie Back to School, this cultivar is highly regarded in the dessert-gas category for its heavy-hitting potency and dense, frosty bag appeal.

Genetic Lineage & Profile

While some early industry sources listed its family tree as a mystery, it is widely recognized as a modern hybrid cross between Z (Zkittlez) and Gelato 41 (G41).

Type: Indica-dominant leaning hybridStructure: Dense calyx stacking, tight internodal spacing, and a heavy coating of trichomes making it visually striking.

Cultivation: Notoriously difficult and sensitive to grow, but highly rewarding for experienced cultivators.

Flavor and Aroma Profile

The strain features a complex, layered "dessert-gas" profile that combines sweet and deeply savory elements:

Aroma: A pungent mix of rubber, musk, tropical fruit, and sweet candy gas.

Flavor: Creamy, doughy sweetness upfront, blending into heavy diesel, cheese, and a peppery-citrus finish.

Dominant Terpenes: Caryophyllene, Limonene, Linalool, Humulene, and Pinene.

Experienced Effects

Triple Lindy delivers a potent "one-two-three punch" that satisfies both physical and cerebral preferences:

Cerebral Lift: An immediate euphoric rush that boosts mood and relieves mental stress.

Body High: A deeply relaxing, heavy physical sedation that spreads across the limbs without immediate couchlock, making it ideal for evening use

569.desc:
True OG x Forum Girl Scout Cookies

Cake Walk is a slightly indica dominant hybrid strain created through crossing the infamous True OG X Forum Girl Scout Cookies strains. Looking to actually relax after a long and stressful day? It'll be a cake walk with this tasty bud. Cakewalk brings a super calming and soothing high that's great for a lazy afternoon or the end of a stressful day when you want relief and you want it fast. You'll feel lifted with a happy sense of relaxation that permeates both mind and body, leaving you tranquil and without a care in the world. This combination quickly turns stoney and sedative, leaving you dozing off before you know it.

570.desc: Dried cannabis flower is primarily ingested via inhalation. Activation time is roughly about 5 minutes and can last up to a few hours.

571.desc:
Lineage: [Original Glue] x [Vino OG]

Breeder: Dungeon Vault Genetics

Top Reported Strain Effects: Relaxed, Calm, Blissful, Uplifted, Euphoric

Top Reported Strain Flavors: Grape, Diesel, Earthy, Pine, Citrus

Dungeon Vault Genetics’ Grapezilla stomps onto the scene as a mighty indica born from Original Glue and Vino OG. With Myrcene leading the charge, expect a mellow, musky earthiness that gently settles the mind, while Pinene’s crisp pine notes sharpen focus and clarity. Caryophyllene adds a peppery warmth that gives each inhale a spicy kick, and Limonene brings a bright citrus twist that lifts the senses. Humulene rounds out the profile with subtle herbal undertones.

572.desc: lce de Uva is an indica dominant hybrid strain (70% indica/30% sativa) created through crossing the mouthwatering Grape Pie X OG Kush strains. Often touted as one of the ‘grapiest' strains you'll ever try, Dulce de Uva is the perfect calming yet arousing bud to help you really kick back. The flavor of Dulce de Uva is definitely fruity with a sugary grape candy effect to it that's intensified by sour citrus and nutty cookies. The aroma is very similar, almost like a bag of sour grape candies accented by touches of sugary vanilla and caramel cookies. The Dulce de Uva high will wash over you a few minutes after your final exhale, beginning as a stimulating physical tingle that can be a bit arousing at times. You'll find that this tingle infuses your mind with a lifted sense of unfocused happiness that can have you feeling a bit giddy and giggly at times. Thanks to these effects and its high 21-25% average THC level, Dulce de Uva is often said to be pefect for treating conditions such as chronic stress or anxiety, depression, chronic pain and nausea. This bud has long and fluffy pepper-shaped blue-green nugs with thin orange hairs and tiny, bright white crystal trichomes.

573.desc: Midz Froot by the Foot 28g is an indica-dominant hybrid bred by Atlas Seed (Mythic OG x Cotton Candy) that yields a sweet, candy-like aroma paired with a sharp, fuel-like background. It delivers a deeply relaxing and heavy body high, making it a highly popular choice for consumers looking for effective stress relief and sleep support.

574.desc: The Yeti 28g "Ready to Roll" pre-ground flower is a highly potent, Indica-dominant hybrid. This product draws from the famous Bubblegum Marker lineage (Sherbert x Permanent Marker) bred by Seed Junky Genetics. It features a unique flavor profile that blends nostalgic, sweet pink bubblegum with sharp, chemical diesel undertones driven by dominant terpenes like limonene and caryophyllene. It is highly regarded for delivering a heavy, full-body relaxation paired with a euphoric cerebral buzz.

575.desc: Smoke Yeti Gas Face 28g Shake is a high-volume, pre-ground bulk cannabis product that offers excellent convenience. Bred by Seed Junky Genetics, the Gas Face strain is a potent hybrid cross of Face Mints with a Biscotti and Sherbet backcross, known for its heavily stinging, fuel-forward diesel aroma and earthy citrus undertones. It delivers deeply calming, physically relaxing effects that help ease anxiety, stress, and physical tension.

576.desc: The Goodies Blue Razz 14g Shake delivers a sweet, fruity aroma dominated by berry notes and a sharp hint of blue raspberry candy. Its high concentrations of Beta-Myrcene and Linalool produce an initial burst of happy, uplifting energy that gently transitions into a deeply calm and relaxed body buzz. This balanced profile makes it highly effective for relieving stress, easing physical tension, and elevating overall mood without causing immediate heavy sedation.

577.desc:
**New Kind Tree Premium Jars**

White Iverson is a Hybrid strain that has a soaring euphoric high which penetrates deep into the body leaving that same body deeper in couch lock. This strain is aromatic with sweet vanilla, candy, and subtle spice notes.

Type: Indica-dominant Hybrid

Lineage: (Zushi x Lemon Cherry Gelato) x Permanent Marker

Top Effects: Calming, Euphoric, Sedative

578.desc: "Big Apple" is an indica-leaning hybrid strain, known for its distinct apple, mint, and menthol flavor profile. It is highly sought after for its balanced effects that can provide both a focused, creative state and a soothing relaxation.

579.desc: Jedi Mind Trick is a Fascade phenotype created by crossing the award winning Paris OG with The Menthol. This hybrid strain has a strong earthy, funky, and herbal aroma. Expect a focused and euphoic effect.

580.desc:
Harvest Moon Farms Purple Elephant (3.5g) is an Indica flower strain known for its deeply relaxing effects and distinct fruit-forward profile. It is widely available across dispensaries in New Jersey.

The true pedigree of Purple Elephant carries a bit of West Coast mystery, but cannabis historians and breeders generally agree on its roots:

The Mother: Purple Urkle, a legendary cultivar originating from the Pacific Northwest (Mendocino/Humboldt County). This passes down the intense grape candy aromatics and heavy, relaxing traits.

The Father: The original cut is believed to be a cross between Purple Urkle and an undisclosed variety—frequently attributed as either a robust Gage Green selection or a mystery Sativa line that added structural heft and larger colas.

Aroma & Flavor
Nose: Breaking open a jar releases a pungent burst of sweet grape candy and musty, damp earth. It is backed by sharp dark berry edges and a woodsy, herbal spice.

Taste: The smoke is smooth and layered. It leads with a heavy sweetness reminiscent of ripe berries and artificial grape candy, finishing with a sharp, kushy earthiness and subtle chemical undertones on the exhale.

Effects & Therapeutic Uses:
While standard cuts of Purple Elephant can occasionally lean into daytime focus, the specific Harvest Moon Farms batch leans into a heavier evening profile:

The High: It hits quickly, initiating a calming euphoria that blankety wraps both mind and body. Users report feeling deeply serene, relaxed, and mildly hungry without immediate couch-lock, though high doses transition quickly into deep sleepiness.

Medical Benefits: According to Leafwell, the strain “is often used for its potential to relieve stress, anxiety, and depression. It may also help with pain management and insomnia due to its relaxing and sedating effects.

581.desc:
RYTHM Mini Buds offer a more accessible way to enjoy flower from the #1 Flower Brand in the World¹. Featuring iconic strains known for high potency, Mini Buds deliver the trusted, reliable experience consumers expect from RYTHM at a more value-driven price point.

Each jar contains smaller buds with a higher piece count, while still preserving lush aromas and rich flavors true to each strain. Carefully cultivated and quality tested, RYTHM Mini Buds are ideal for everyday enjoyment, offering excellent performance, consistent effects, and exceptional value.

Purple Starfruit [orig: Platinum GSC x LilMissHS] is an indica that delivers deep berry on the inhale, easing into creamy sweetness, gentle earth, and floral funk.

582.desc: Yeti Stuffed Cherry Gelato (3.5g) is a high-potency, indica-dominant hybrid cannabis flower bred by Raw Genetics by crossing Stuffed French Toast with Lemon Cherry Gelato. This eighth-ounce pre-pack is highly regarded in the legal market for its exceptional terpene profile—often testing between 3.20% and 3.55% total terpenes—which delivers a complex, dessert-like aroma of sweet maraschino cherry syrup, creamy vanilla, and maple, rounded out by a sharp, fuel-like finish. It kicks off with a smooth, mood-boosting cerebral lift before settling into a deeply relaxing, heavy-bodied physical calm, making it a highly sought-after and budget-friendly option for evening stress relief.

583.desc: EXOTICA GARDENS presents GG4, a legendary indica flower in a convenient 3.5g pre-pack format. Also known as Gorilla Glue 4, this powerhouse strain delivers deeply relaxing effects that melt away stress and tension. GG4 is celebrated for its pungent, earthy aroma with notes of pine and diesel fuel, creating a distinctive profile that's instantly recognizable. The flavor follows through with rich, woody undertones accented by hints of coffee and chocolate. Perfect for evening use, this indica promotes full-body relaxation, making it ideal for unwinding after a long day or easing into restful sleep. Users often report feeling euphoric, happy, and deeply calm. Whether you're seeking relief or simply want to relax, this 3.5g jar of GG4 flower delivers consistent quality and potent effects that have made it a cannabis community favorite.

584.desc:
Feelz | Hooch | Flower | 14g

Hooch is an indica-dominant weed strain bred by Purple City Genetics from a genetic cross of Slurty3 x Street Guru. This is a strain heavy on the bag appeal, with gaudy, sage-colored buds flecked with purple and ample trichomes. Hooch blends the sweet, berry, minty, diesel, and herbal aromas and flavors of its many parent strains. Consumers and medical patients can expect relaxing and euphoric effects.

585.desc:
Strain Overview: Dulce de Papaya
• Lineage: An indica-leaning hybrid cross of Dulce de Uva × Papaya (originally bred by Bloom Seed Co).
• Aroma & Flavor: Features a tropical fusion of ripe papaya, sweet grape candy, and creamy citrus, backed by subtle tropical funk and earthy spice.
• Effects: Provides an initial uplifting wave of euphoria and mental clarity that transitions into a soothing, full-body relaxation

586.desc: Harvest Moon Farms Sticky Bobbi 7g is a premium, Indica-dominant hybrid cannabis flower (a cross of Sunshine x Purple Flamingo). Known for its sweet, skunky aroma with citrus and earthy undertones, this strain delivers a balanced experience that starts with a bright, euphoric, and creative lift before settling into a deeply relaxing body high. The 7g quarter-ounce package offers high-quality full buds ideal for users seeking both functional creativity and physical relaxation.

587.desc:
• The Genotype Profile: "Special Z" is selected to capture the bright, sweet, candy-heavy attributes of original Zkittlez, often crossed with a secret or proprietary balancing strain to optimize trichome density and structural growth.

• Aroma Profile: It leans much heavier into a sweet, artificial fruity candy and tropical citrus profile, scaling back slightly on the heavy, skunky diesel "funk" that dominates their other Z-hybrids.

• Effects: Consumers generally find it to be a slightly more balanced or uplifting Hybrid/Indica-Hybrid experience compared to their pure sedative offerings, providing functional physical relaxation with a more prominent cerebral, euphoric buzz.

588.desc: First Round Pick by Hugh Douglas is a hard-hitting, premium Indica-Hybrid cannabis strain. It delivers a sharp, pungent aroma dominated by bright lemon and citrus notes, rounded out by a sweet, earthy, and herbal depth driven by its top terpenes, Limonene, Myrcene, and Linalool. Because of its high potency and negligible CBD, this strain provides a deeply calming, physical body high and heavy relaxation, making it an ideal choice for evening use, stress relief, and winding down.

589.desc: A cross between JMO and Slurup created Candied Garlic a strain that captivates with its irresistible combination of super chewy calyx structures. The initial notes of garlic and gas create an intense flavor explosion while the delightful hints of berries and cake on the back end add a surprising sweetness.

590.desc:
Bring bold flavor and standout genetics to your flower rotation with Facetz by Delight. This balanced 50/50 hybrid comes from Pavé x Gastro Pop #5, bred by Compound Genetics, and catches the eye with prismatic green buds and frosty, milky calyxes. Its complex flavor profile blends pungent diesel and savory cheese with juicy berry notes, while select expressions may lean toward fruity sweetness or minty fuel.

Facetz is associated with a happy, uplifted, creative vibe balanced by a calming edge, making it a versatile option for a variety of sessions.

591.desc:
Lineage: Y8 (Ylife x 8 Mile Runtz) x Lemon Cherry Sherbert

Panther Runts by Dan Trocki Farms is a premium cannabis flower featuring a sweet, candy-inspired flavor profile with hints of tropical fruit, creamy undertones, and subtle earthy gas. Drawing inspiration from the classic Runtz family of strains, Panther Runts offers an aromatic experience that combines fruity sweetness with a rich, pungent finish.

592.desc:
My Dad’s Stash’s Heir Heads is a flavorful flower offering a classic, balanced profile with a modern polish in a convenient 3.5g format. Built from Heirloom Hybrid lineage, it delivers an approachable character for enthusiasts who appreciate smooth, dependable flower.

Expect earthy spice layered with subtle sweetness for a refined aroma and flavorful smoke. The profile is balanced and easygoing, blending classic cannabis character with a clean, polished finish.

Heir Heads offers a smooth, reliable experience that makes it an easy addition to any flower rotation, whether you’re enjoying a solo session or sharing with friends.

593.desc: "Zoltar" by My Dad's Stash is a potent, indica-dominant hybrid cannabis strain available in 3.5-gram flower jars. Crossing OGKB 2.1 with Jar Jar Stinks, this premium flower delivers a heavy complex, pungent aroma of diesel, savory garlic, sweet cookie dough, and warm spices. Users report that the experience begins with a happy, euphoric head rush before deeply settling into a heavy physical relaxation, making it an ideal choice for a sedative evening unwind or a total "brain turn-off" at the end of the day.

594.desc:
Aroma and Flavor:

Smell: Sharp diesel, chemical fuel, and sweet rubber funk.

Taste: A complex mix of fuel, rubber, and subtle citrus or coffee notes.

Effects:

Mind: An uplifting, euphoric, and creative cerebral buzz.

Body: A smooth transition into deep relaxation and stress relief without heavy sedation.

595.desc: This potent strain delivers the deep relaxation and calming effects indica enthusiasts crave, making it ideal for unwinding after a long day or settling in for a restful evening. Chem 51 captivates with its distinct chemical and fuel-forward aroma profile, accented by earthy undertones that speak to its legendary lineage. Each nug is carefully cultivated and hand-selected to ensure exceptional quality and consistency. Whether you're seeking relief from tension, looking to ease into a peaceful night's sleep, or simply want to melt away stress, this half-ounce of Chem 51 delivers a classic indica experience with every session. Perfect for seasoned consumers who appreciate bold flavors and powerful, full-bodied effects.

596.desc: Graham Cracker (Brownie Scout x Head Cracker) is an indica with a distinct flavor profile featuring a blend of sweet, spicy, nutty and herbal notes.

597.desc: Gold Cash Gold is a slightly indica dominant hybrid strain (60% indica/40% sativa) created through crossing the delicious Oreoz X Pure Michigan strains. If you've been seeking out a truly amazing bud with the perfect flavor and soaring, happy high, you've found everything you need with Gold Cash Gold. The taste of this bud is truly money, with a blend of sweet, creamy chocolate cookies accented by touches of spicy black pepper. The aroma takes things up a notch, adding in layers of spicy diesel that perfect accent the nutty, chocolate and vanilla cookie scent. The Gold Cash Gold high will settle in slowly, beginning with a creeping, lifted build that boosts your spirits and has you feeling happy and completely care-free. You'll feel socially inspired and ready to get chatting with a light touch of creativity that keeps your mind active. A stoney body high wraps things up, sinking into your entire physical form and locking you down to the couch with a heavy, immovable sedation. With these effects, Gold Cash Gold is often suggested to treat a variety of conditions including chronic pain, chronic fatigue, chronic stress, depression or mood swings, arthritis and inflammation. This bud has dense and conical, bright neon green nugs with lots of furry orange hairs, rich golden undertones and a frosty coating of chunky, amber-tinted gold crystal trichomes.

598.desc:
Megaleaf Harambe Glue delivers a premium eighth of dense, trichome-rich flower featuring a bold terpene profile that combines classic earthy funk with rich fuel-forward character. The aroma is packed with pungent diesel, fresh pine, earthy herbs, and subtle cocoa-like sweetness, creating a robust bouquet that immediately stands out to fans of classic glue-style cultivars.

On the inhale, expect layers of earthy kush, peppery spice, diesel fuel, and hints of pine with a smooth, lingering finish. Carefully cultivated and expertly cured, each bud burns evenly while producing thick, flavorful smoke that highlights the cultivar's rich terpene expression from beginning to end.

Effects are deeply relaxing and long-lasting, delivering an initial wave of happy cerebral euphoria before gradually settling into soothing full-body comfort. Harambe Glue is an excellent choice for evening sessions or anyone seeking bold, gas-forward flavor paired with dependable hybrid-to-indica effects.

599.desc: Blue Harvest’s Dosi Cake is a premium, indica-dominant hybrid cannabis strain (a cross of Do-Si-Dos and Wedding Cake) cultivated by an independent craft grower in New Jersey. It features a rich terpene profile dominated by myrcene and caryophyllene, giving it an earthy, spicy, and subtly sweet dessert flavor profile. The effects begin with an uplifting, euphoric head high before transitioning into a deeply relaxing, heavy body sedation, making it an excellent choice for evening relaxation, stress relief, or managing insomnia.

600.desc:
PINEAPPLE OG
LINEAGE: OG Kush x Sour Grape

A sophisticated palate will truly appreciate this loud pineapple flavor and gassy funk alongside hints of ripe guava and sour grapes. This deeply relaxing strain melts stress away at the end of a busy day. 

Pineapple OG’s complex terpene profile enhances every experience you enjoy. A direct descendant of Wonderbrett's original OG Kush.

Terpenes: Limonene, Myrcene, Linalool, Humulene
Experience: Heavy

601.desc: Black Maple is a visually appealing, resin-rich strain with a name that reflects its characteristic maple-like sweetness. Expect an aromatic and flavorful experience blending grape/citrus sweetness, roasted or caramel undertones, diesel/gas notes, and a spicy/earthy finish.

602.desc: Gold Cash Gold is a dazzling strain that lives up to its luxurious name, showcasing dense, trichome-covered buds that shimmer with hues of deep green and hints of gold. Its aroma is rich and inviting, blending sweet citrus and earthy spice with subtle notes of pine. On the palate, Gold Cash Gold delivers a smooth, flavorful experience—mixing creamy sweetness with a touch of herbal zest, leaving a lingering, golden finish that feels both fresh and indulgent.

603.desc: The "One" by Brute's Roots is a popular Indica-dominant hybrid cannabis strain available at New Jersey dispensaries. It is widely celebrated for its sweet, woody pine aroma and potent, deeply relaxing effects that are known to leave users happy, sleepy, and stress-free

604.desc: Smooth, sweet, and straight to the point—Blue Velvet is an indica-hybrid classic with serious staying power. A cross of Purple Thai and Afghani, giving you a knockout combo of old-school flavor and modern potency. Expect juicy blueberry sweetness up front with earthy spice and floral undertones that make every pull rich and memorable. The terpene lineup works like a lullaby with teeth. Limonene sparks the citrus zest and lifts your mood, linalool brings that floral calm to hush your edges, and myrcene drapes over you like a weighted blanket. The high hits in two waves—first a euphoric head buzz, then a slow, heavy melt that tells your body it’s time to let go. Grown Rogue grows with precision, dialing in dense, resin-coated buds that show off the full spectrum of their genetics. Blue Velvet belongs in the Dream category for a reason—when you want flavor, power, and a smooth slide into the night, this strain doesn’t just deliver, it tucks you in.

605.desc: Phantom Planet is an indica-dominant strain that begins with heightened energy and ends with a crash of full-body relaxation. Its aroma is a rich combination of pine and lemon accented by a subtle menthol flavor. The initial euphoric jolt launches you into a happy, dreamy state of mind with fits of giggles and fixated concentration. Over time, you may notice some mental jamming, absent-mindedness, and impending sleepiness.

The initial euphoric jolt launches you into a happy, dreamy state of mind with fits of giggles and fixated concentration. 607.desc: Allday Flame Princess 3.5g flower is crafted for customers who want smooth smoke, easy convenience, and a flavorful ready-to-enjoy experience. Flame Princess brings a bold, approachable character with a smooth finish, making each pull simple, enjoyable, and satisfying from spark to finish.

608.desc: Allday Flame Princess 3.5g flower is crafted for customers who want smooth smoke, easy convenience, and a flavorful ready-to-enjoy experience. Flame Princess brings a bold, approachable character with a smooth finish, making each pull simple, enjoyable, and satisfying from spark to finish.

609.desc: Tear Gas produced by Grown Rogue is an indoor-grown, indica-dominant hybrid cannabis strain. Cultivated by Grown Rogue Cannabis across premium markets like Oregon, Michigan, and New Jersey, this specific flower is widely recognized for its heavy, pungent aroma and dual-action effects.

610.desc: The Cut Mac Stomper 7g is a 7-gram flower option of the MAC Stomper strain, an indica-dominant hybrid bred from MAC (Miracle Alien Cookies) and Grape Stomper.

611.desc: Cookies Small Batch Tut (3.5g) is an indica-leaning hybrid cannabis flower from the California-founded brand Cookies, known for its earthy, subtly sweet flavor and relaxing, evening-oriented effects.

612.desc: Good Green’s “Cranberry Z” delivers a bright, tart aroma of fresh cranberries layered with sweet candy, citrus zest, and a hint of earthy funk. The flavor is juicy and tangy, blending sour berry notes with a sugary, candy-like smoothness on the exhale. Its buds are typically dense and colorful, showing deep green tones with flashes of red and purple hues, fiery orange pistils, and a thick, sparkling coat of frosty trichomes that gives it a vibrant, fruit-forward finish.

613.desc: Mini Buds offer a variety of expertly cultivated and meticulously cured strains with optimal potencies, lush aromas, and rich flavors. Face Off OG x Animal Mints is a potent | Indica-leaning strain with a complex flavor profile of sweet mint, citrus, and nuts with hints of pine and diesel.

614.desc:
Profile and Genetics

Better still, GMO Cookies delivers everything you’ll want from a classic Indica hybrid—including complete mind and body relaxation, enhanced mental focus, and uplifted emotions. 

Likewise, the strain is known for battling various health conditions, such as depression, chronic pain, insomnia, stress, fatigue, and body inflammation.

The high produced from Violet Fog is one that's perfect for a lazy evening or afternoon, with hazy and unfocused effects that are perfect for helping you settle down after a long and stressful day. The Unicorn Poop high is just as delightful, with a euphoric overtone that will leave both mind and body flying high for hours on end. A soothing body high accompanies this heady state, helping you to relax with an almost weightless sense that won't tie you down to the couch.

The aroma and flavor lean sweet and creamy, with vanilla, sweet cream, and subtle fruity notes on the inhale, plus a light gassy or earthy edge underneath. Visually, it’s typically dense and frosty, with resin-coated buds that suggest strong potency and a premium bag appeal.

Users who enjoy flavorful strains often like Vanilla Sprinklez for its dessert-like character and soothing, versatile high. In practice, it suits people looking for a relaxing strain that still keeps the experience smooth rather than overly sedating.

654.desc:
Dungeon Vault Genetics’ Grapezilla stomps onto the scene as a mighty indica born from Original Glue and Vino OG. With Myrcene leading the charge, expect a mellow, musky earthiness that gently settles the mind, while Pinene’s crisp pine notes sharpen focus and clarity. Caryophyllene adds a peppery warmth that gives each inhale a spicy kick, and Limonene brings a bright citrus twist that lifts the senses. Humulene rounds out the profile with subtle herbal undertones.

Upon first puff, sweet grape flavors surge forward, underscored by a low rumble of diesel funk inherited from its Glue parentage. Myrcene’s cozy musk weaves through that grape sweetness, while Pinene’s refreshing forest breeze cuts through the richness. Caryophyllene’s peppery spice and Limonene’s lemon-lime flair mingle on the exhale, leaving a complex aftertaste that invites another toke.

Grapezilla’s effects mirror its terpene tapestry: a gradual wave of calm that encourages deep relaxation and puts the body at ease. Pinene’s clarity helps keep the mind gently engaged, so you can dive into a good book, sink into your favorite playlist, or simply relish a quiet moment. Caryophyllene’s warm embrace and Myrcene’s soothing weight make sinking into the couch all but inevitable, yet Limonene’s lift ensures you never lose complete alertness - truly the apex of chill.

864.desc:
We are excited to introduce THCV Rich Lemon Lime Soft Lozenges, the newest addition to our line of ratio-formulated products! The goal of our ratio-formulated line is to provide our patients with access to a line of diverse cannabinoid products that meet their specific relief and wellness needs with targeted, adjustable effects. Our THCV-Rich Soft Lozenges are unique in their formulation, because we source THCV from the in-house extraction of our own THCV-rich cultivars.

WHAT IS THCV?
Tetrahydrocannabivarin (THCV) is a lesser known cannabinoid that is starting to gain more attention for its potential appetite suppressant and energy stimulating effects. To date, THCV-forward products have not been widely available because THCV is typically found in low concentrations in many cultivars. As a result, cultivating for THCV isolate production can be costly for growers, and, consequently, the isolate may be prohibitively expensive for extract manufacturers seeking to formulate with THCV.

With this in mind, we undertook a search for cultivars that have higher concentrations of THCV. In the course of that search, we were able to find strains that, when grown at scale, allowed us to extract enough THCV for our ratio-formulated product line. 

BENEFITS
Because THCV has only recently gained attention, and because cannabis studies in general face a myriad of legal and financial obstacles, studies on THCV’s effects and symptom relief are limited. However, available research has found THCV to potentially reduce appetite, increase energy, and soothe anxiety. There is also some evidence that suggests it may curb some of THC’s intoxicating effects such as verbal recall issues, making it a potential option for patients seeking a product that allows them to be more functional during the day.

SYNERGISTIC EFFECTS:
This THCV-rich option is being offered in combination with THC because even in trace amounts, combinations of cannabinoids can produce a more effective response for patients' symptom relief. This is commonly referred to as the “Entourage Effect.”

Highly Co. Labs Pink Lemonade Soluble Rosin Powder is a fast-acting, water-soluble cannabis drink mix crafted via solventless ice-water extraction to preserve live rosin terpenes. Taste Profile

Pure Terpene Flavor: Because it contains zero added sugars, artificial dyes, or chemicals, the flavor relies primarily on the natural, full-spectrum live rosin.

Notes: Expect a bright, crisp blend of zesty lemon candy, tart grapefruit, and subtle sweet berry undertones from the Pink Lemonade strain profile. It finishes with a clean, slightly herbal, and earthy cannabis note.

Expected Effects

Fast Onset: Traditional edibles must pass through your liver, taking 1–2 hours to hit. This micro-encapsulated powder absorbs through your lymphatic system and sublingual pathways, kicking in within 5 to 15 minutes.

The "Social" Vibe: The balanced 1:1:1 THC, CBD, and CBG ratio generates an energetic, euphoric, and highly functional head high.

No Couch-Lock: The heavy body sedation typical of standard edibles is replaced by a bright, clear-headed buzz that keeps you talkative and relaxed. It is often described as an "inhalation-style" high without the smoke.

How to Consume It

The packaging includes a small measuring scoop (typically 10mg of cannabinoids per scoop) for precise dosing. You can consume it in three versatile ways:

Dissolve on Your Tongue: The fastest and most efficient delivery method. Simply place a scoop directly into your mouth and let it dissolve sublingually.

Mix Into Drinks: Because it is water-soluble, it blends smoothly without clumping. Stir a scoop into cold water, iced tea, or real lemonade to create an instant infused beverage.

Sprinkle on Food: You can lightly dust the powder over snacks or meals to effortlessly infuse your food

While the kush female in this cross, Deadhead OG, contributes a long-lasting body high and an abbreviated flowering time, this phenotype is dominated by its male parent, Tom Hill Haze. Originally sourced from Sam the Skunkman’s stock by Tom Hill himself, the legendary Tom Hill Haze strain has established itself as a mainstay among cannabis breeders and gardeners since the 1990’s. A well-respected grower and breeder in the NorCal region who has been working with the cannabis plant for decades, Tom Hill specializes in the preservation of pure lines and offers seeds and hybrids of heritage cannabis varieties.

Our phenotype of Deadhead OG x Tom Hill Haze is a towering plant with a tremendous growth rate. She can double the size of other plants in the same amount of vegetative time. Buds stack and form significant colas, requiring considerable support. Complex smells of haze are ever-present, maybe best described as an herbaceous ammonia. The herbs and tea leaves meld with a slight lemony citrus and eventually give way to a hardwood floor cleaner aroma of bleach. As to be expected, an uptick in energy and increased mood are commonly felt when consuming this variety. The Deadhead OG x Tom Hill Haze is sure to excite those nostalgic senses of prior decades’ Haze invasion.

931.desc:
Nose:
The raw smell of this jar is so interesting that I kept sniffing at it, trying to work out what notes I was getting. At first it's an almost creamy funk that leans cheese, with a sweet floral in the middle that lays low but stays bright. That cheese smell is really just the funk, floral and cream wafting in my face. Broken down, the floral takes the front, but it's softer than the nose unbroken, and you need to have your nose an inch from the top to get any smell.

Taste:
Floral takes the front seat and stays there, with a strong palate coat of an almost perfume flavor and a strong chem-earthy note. Halfway through it shifts to a more woody taste, with a slight tang of sweetness as the woody pulls back. A balanced floral and sweetness comes back to the front and rides out to the end; a slight earthy, woody tang sits on the tip of my tongue, but otherwise it's reduced itself to the backend of the inhale. In the final stretch it just sits as a soft floral with a hint of sweetness at the back. Grey/white, even burn.

High:
A very functional high: get work done, take a walk, clean something. It doesn't slump me down or keep me locked in, just gives a really decent boost of energy. Short-lasting though, with a consistent pressure bubble surrounding the upper body, and it lasted 43 minutes total.

Aroma: The Jack Herer strain boasts a distinctive aroma reminiscent of Pine-Sol, with lemony pine notes accented by earthy herbs and spicy flowers. Its fresh, crisp scent is instantly recognizable and adds to its appeal.

Flavor: On the palate, Jack Herer offers a sweet and sour citrusy lemon flavor with a woody pine exhale. This combination of tangy citrus and earthy pine provides a refreshing and enjoyable taste.

Jack Herer delivers an energizing and clear-headed high that can be felt almost immediately after exhaling. Its effects include:

Euphoric Lift: A clear-headed euphoria that enhances your mood, promoting a sense of motivation and mental clarity.
